title: Pad Thai
description: Street-food-style pad Thai: soaked rice stick noodles stir-fried with a tamarind, palm sugar and fish sauce sauce, prawns, tofu, egg, pickled radish, garlic chives, bean shoots and peanuts.

ingredients.name: rice noodles
ingredients.note: dried thin rice stick, no thicker than 3 mm

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: or pork lard (the page lists lard first); for the sauce

ingredients.name: shallot
ingredients.note: small Asian, finely chopped, for the sauce

ingredients.name: tamarind paste
ingredients.note: concentrate or puree, for the sauce

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: or pork lard (the page lists lard first); for stir-frying, plus a scant 1 tsp extra for the egg

ingredients.name: prawns
ingredients.note: large, deveined and peeled, tails intact

ingredients.name: chives
ingredients.note: Chinese (garlic) chive stems, trimmed and cut into 5 cm batons, plus extra to serve

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: a splash, for tossing the noodles

ingredients.name: bean sprouts
ingredients.note: a decent handful (about 1/3 cup), plus extra to serve

steps.text: Soak the rice stick noodles in room-temperature water for about 30 minutes.
For the sauce, heat the 50 g oil or lard in a small pan over medium-high heat and cook the shallots and dried shrimp for 3–4 minutes, until soft but not browned.

Add the palm sugar, tamarind, fish sauce and white sugar, then simmer gently on medium for 3–4 minutes, until the sugar dissolves and the sauce thickens slightly. The recipe makes twice what you need; half keeps in the fridge for a week.
Heat the 2 tbsp oil or lard in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the prawns for 2–3 minutes, until almost cooked. Add the tofu and stir-fry 2 minutes more, until golden.
Push everything to one side, add a scant teaspoon of oil or lard to the empty side and pour in the eggs. Let them set into a thin omelette, then flip and toss them through.
Add the pickled radish and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Add half the chives, the soaked noodles, half the sauce and about 2 tablespoons of water, and toss for 3–4 minutes, until the noodles are tender.
Toss through the remaining chives and the bean shoots, divide between plates, and top with peanuts. Serve with chilli powder, lime and extra chives and bean shoots.

title: Pad See Ew
description: Wide rice noodles caramelised in a very hot wok with chicken, Chinese broccoli and egg in a dark soy and oyster sauce.

ingredients.name: rice noodles
ingredients.note: dried wide rice stick noodles, or 450 g fresh sen yai

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.note: light or all-purpose, for the sauce

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: peanut or vegetable; 1 tbsp then 2 tbsp

steps.text: Trim the Chinese broccoli and cut into 7.5 cm pieces, separating leaves from stems. Halve thick stems lengthways so none is wider than about 8 mm.
Cook the noodles to the packet directions and drain, timing it so they are fresh when they go into the wok. Mix the sauce ingredients until the sugar dissolves.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Cook the garlic for 15 seconds, add the chicken and cook until it mostly turns white.
Add the broccoli stems and cook until the chicken is almost done, then add the leaves until just wilted.
Push everything to one side, crack the egg in and scramble it. Remove it all to a plate and scrape the wok clean.
Heat 2 tbsp oil over high heat until smoking. Add the noodles and sauce and toss as little as possible so the sauce spreads and the edges caramelise, about 1-1.5 minutes.
Quickly return the chicken and vegetables, toss to mix and serve immediately.

title: Thai Green Curry
description: Chicken thigh simmered in coconut milk and stock with green curry paste, makrut lime leaves, Thai eggplant and Thai basil, served with jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: basil
ingredients.note: Thai basil, finely julienned, for the optional enhanced paste

ingredients.name: fingerroot
ingredients.note: krachai, 1 piece, optional, for the enhanced paste

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.note: divided, about 3/4 cup for frying the paste

ingredients.name: palm sugar
ingredients.note: finely chopped, or light brown sugar

ingredients.name: aubergine
ingredients.note: Thai eggplant, bite-sized, or a 540 g can of bamboo shoots

ingredients.name: capsicum
ingredients.note: red, or another mild red pepper, julienned

ingredients.name: basil
ingredients.note: 1 cup Thai basil leaves, loosely packed

steps.text: Optional: pound the julienned Thai basil, fingerroot, shrimp paste and curry paste together into a paste to boost flavour and colour.
Bring about 3/4 cup of the coconut milk to a full boil in a heavy pot. Add the curry paste and stir often until the coconut oil separates, 3-5 minutes.
Stir the chicken thigh pieces through the paste.
Add the stock, remaining 1 cup coconut milk, palm sugar and 1 tbsp fish sauce, plus the bruised, torn lime leaves. Simmer gently for 10-15 minutes until the chicken is fork tender.
Add the eggplant pieces, pushing them under for the first minute, and cook 2 minutes more until just pierced by a fork. Bamboo shoots only need a minute to heat through.
Turn off the heat, stir in the red pepper, then the Thai basil. Adjust with more fish sauce and serve with jasmine rice.

title: Massaman beef curry
description: Beef chuck simmered until tender, then added to a from-scratch massaman paste and coconut sauce with potatoes, finished with peanuts and served over jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: lemongrass
ingredients.note: stalk, white part chopped for the paste, trimmings go in the beef

ingredients.name: dried chillies
ingredients.note: dried red Asian, seeds shaken out

ingredients.name: chuck steak
ingredients.note: beef chuck, cut into 4 cm cubes

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.note: medium-small, peeled, cut into 2.5 cm pieces

ingredients.name: peanuts
ingredients.note: roughly chopped, scattered over to finish (the page calls them essential)

ingredients.name: fried shallots
ingredients.note: crispy Asian fried shallots, optional, to garnish

steps.text: Trim the lemongrass, finely chopping the white part for the paste and keeping the trimmings. Simmer the beef in the broth with the bay leaves and trimmings, topped up with water so the liquid almost covers it, for 1.5 to 2 hours until fork tender. Lift out the beef, reduce the liquid to about 1.5 cups if there is much more, and set it aside.

Char the shallots, garlic and galangal in a smoking-hot dry skillet for about 1.5 minutes, then char the dried chillies for 10 seconds a side. Cool, grate the galangal, peel the garlic and shake out the chilli seeds.
Toast the ground spices in a dry skillet for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Blitz the chillies, then add the galangal, chopped lemongrass, toasted spices and remaining paste ingredients with the water until smooth.
Cook the paste in the oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes until thick and fragrant. Add the coconut milk, cinnamon, star anise and the reserved braising liquid and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in the fish sauce, tamarind and sugar, add the potatoes and cook 7 minutes until tender.
Add the beef and simmer 2 minutes until the sauce thickens, adjusting the salty, sour and sweet balance.
Serve over steamed jasmine rice topped with the chopped peanuts, plus fried shallots and sliced chilli if you like.

title: Panang chicken curry
description: Chicken thigh cooked in reduced coconut milk with a homemade panang paste of dried chillies, lemongrass, galangal and roasted peanuts, finished with kaffir lime leaves.

ingredients.name: dried chillies
ingredients.note: red spur, soaked 15 min and deseeded, for the paste

ingredients.name: lime leaves
ingredients.note: kaffir, 3–4, plus extra julienned to garnish

steps.text: Blend or pound the soaked chillies, shallots, coriander roots, lemongrass, garlic, lime zest, galangal, shrimp paste, roasted spices, peanuts, salt and white pepper into a smooth paste.
Reduce 1/2 cup of the coconut milk in a wok over medium-high heat until thick and creamy.
Stir in 5 tbsp of the curry paste over medium-low heat for a few minutes until the coconut oil separates.
Add the palm sugar and kaffir lime leaves and cook about a minute until the sugar dissolves.
Toss in the chicken. When it is about half cooked, add the rest of the coconut milk and stir about 30 seconds until cooked through, adding a splash of water if dry.
Add the fish sauce and cook the curry for 5 minutes.
Stir in red pepper, turn off the heat, garnish with julienned lime leaves and more red pepper, and serve with jasmine rice.

title: Tom kha gai
description: Thai coconut chicken soup simmered with galangal, lemongrass, shallot, tomato, mushrooms and lime leaves, finished with lime juice and herbs, served with jasmine rice.

ingredients.name: lemongrass
ingredients.note: large (or 2 small), pounded, cut in 2-inch pieces

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.note: sliced into bite-size pieces; or 2 thighs

ingredients.name: lime juice
ingredients.note: freshly squeezed; up to 1/3 cup for a tangier soup

steps.text: Cut the lemongrass into 5 cm pieces and pound it, pound the galangal and chillies, dice the shallots, remove the stems from the lime leaves, cut the tomato into 6-8 wedges and slice the chicken into bite-size pieces.
Pour the stock into a wok or medium pot and add the lemongrass, galangal and shallot. Simmer over medium heat to release their fragrance.
Add the palm sugar, fish sauce, coconut milk, tomato, mushrooms, chicken, the lime leaves (torn) and chilli. Stir gently and bring to a light simmer.
Cook gently over medium heat for about 6 minutes, until the chicken is cooked, the tomato soft and the mushrooms done.
Stir in the chopped spring onion and coriander and turn off the heat. Add the lime juice last, starting with 1/4 cup and adding up to 1/3 cup to taste.
Serve as a soup, or with warm jasmine rice.

title: Drunken noodles
description: Wide rice noodles stir-fried with chicken, garlic, chilli, onion and basil in an oyster and soy sauce, ready in about 15 minutes.

ingredients.name: chilli
ingredients.note: bird's eye, deseeded, very finely chopped

ingredients.name: chicken thigh
ingredients.note: cut into bite-size pieces; breast also works

ingredients.name: basil
ingredients.note: Thai or holy basil leaves; regular basil works

steps.text: Cook the rice noodles following the packet directions and drain.
Mix the oyster sauce, light and dark soy sauce, sugar and water in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a wok or heavy skillet over high heat. Add the garlic and chilli and cook for 10 seconds.
Add the sliced onion and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and fish sauce and fry until the chicken is cooked, about 2 minutes.
Add the spring onion, noodles and sauce and cook for 1 minute until the sauce reduces and coats the noodles.
Take off the heat, add the basil and toss until just wilted. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken with chillies & basil
description: Quick Thai-style stir-fry of chicken with garlic, chilli and a glossy oyster-soy sauce, finished with a handful of basil and served with rice.

ingredients.name: spring onion
ingredients.note: cut into 4 cm lengths, white and green parts separated

ingredients.name: chilli
ingredients.note: bird's eye or Thai, deseeded and finely chopped

steps.text: Mix the oyster sauce, light and dark soy sauce, sugar and water in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a wok or pan over high heat. Add the garlic and chilli and cook for 10 seconds.
Add the white part of the spring onion and the chicken and fry until cooked, about 2 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and cook for 1 minute until it reduces to a thick glossy sauce.
Toss through the green part of the spring onion and the basil until just wilted. Serve straight away with steamed jasmine rice.

title: Japanese Katsudon
description: Sliced tonkatsu pork cutlet simmered with onion in a seasoned cheat's dashi, set with beaten egg and slid over rice.

ingredients.name: sushi rice
ingredients.note: uncooked short-grain Japanese rice, to make the 3–4 cups cooked rice (about 1 cup raw makes 3 cups cooked)

ingredients.name: watercress
ingredients.note: mitsuba, snow pea shoots or watercress, to serve

steps.text: Make the cheat's dashi by mixing the fish sauce into the water, then stir in the soy sauce, sake and mirin for the seasoning liquid.
Have the tonkatsu cooked and cut into slices. The video fries it a little less so it does not overcook later.
In a frying pan about the size of the serving bowl, combine half the seasoning liquid, 1 tsp sugar and half the onion. Simmer until the onion softens.
Lay half the sliced tonkatsu on top, pour over half the beaten egg and cover with a lid. Steam 2-3 minutes until the egg is barely set.
Meanwhile put half the rice in a bowl. Slide the pan contents on top in one motion.
Top with mitsuba or a substitute and a sprinkle of shichimi togarashi. Repeat for the second bowl.

title: Chicken katsu curry
description: Panko-crumbed chicken cutlets served with rice and a smooth, mildly spiced homemade curry sauce built on stock, apple, carrot and a roux.

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.note: scraps from about 1 onion, for the stock

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.note: scraps from 1-2 carrots, for the stock

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: for the stock, or to taste

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.note: butterflied and halved into four pieces

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: neutral, about 5 cm deep, for frying

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: flaky, optional, to finish the chicken

ingredients.name: sushi rice
ingredients.note: cooked Japanese short-grain; 3-4 cups, to serve

steps.text: Simmer the stock with the onion and carrot scraps, a garlic clove and a piece of ginger for at least 20 minutes, then strain.
Cook the sliced onion with the salt in oil over medium-low heat for about 25 minutes until deeply golden and jammy, adding a splash of water if it sticks.

Stir in the garlic and ginger for a minute, then the apple, carrot, potato, bay leaf, curry powder and dry spices. Pour in 1 litre of the stock and simmer 20 to 30 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Remove the bay leaf and set aside a few carrot and potato pieces. Blend the rest of the curry until smooth.

Melt the butter, cook the flour until light brown and nutty, then stir in the curry powder for 30 seconds. Whisk in the blended curry and the remaining stock, then the Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, ketchup and honey. Simmer 10 minutes, season, and add the chocolate if using.
Butterfly and halve the chicken breasts, pound to about 1.2 cm, and season with salt and white pepper. Dredge in potato starch, then egg, then panko, and rest on a rack for 15 minutes.
Fry in neutral oil at about 175 C for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Drain on a rack, salt lightly and rest 2 to 3 minutes before slicing.
Plate rice on one side and curry on the other with the reserved vegetables, lay the sliced chicken down the middle, and finish with parsley.

title: Chicken Karaage
description: Ginger-and-soy marinated chicken, fried until shatteringly crisp.

steps.text: Add the ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sake and sugar to a bowl and whisk to combine. Add the chicken, then stir to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

Add 1 inch of vegetable oil to a heavy bottomed pot and heat until the oil reaches 360 degrees F. Line a wire rack with 2 sheets of paper towels and get your tongs out. Put the potato starch in a bowl
Add a handful of chicken to the potato starch and toss to coat each piece evenly.
Fry the karaage in batches until the exterior is a medium brown and the chicken is cooked through. Transfer the fried chicken to the paper towel lined rack.
If you want the karaage to stay crispy longer, you can fry the chicken a second time, until it's a darker color after it's cooled off once. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Honey teriyaki salmon
description: Salmon fillets brushed with sesame oil, rubbed with a paprika spice mix and baked under a simmered honey, soy and pineapple teriyaki sauce.

ingredients.name: salmon fillet
ingredients.note: about 5 fillets, thawed and patted dry

ingredients.name: sesame oil
ingredients.note: for greasing: brushed lightly on the salmon, amount not given

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C. Line a casserole dish with foil if you like, add the salmon fillets and brush them very lightly with sesame oil.
Mix the rub's smoked paprika, garlic powder, black pepper and salt and sprinkle it generously over the salmon. Set aside.

In a saucepan over medium-low heat, combine the honey, soy sauce, pineapple juice, brown sugar, lemon juice, vinegar, sesame oil and the sauce's black pepper, cayenne, smoked paprika and garlic powder. Stir, then bring to a very light simmer.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes without letting it boil, then take it off the heat and cool until warm.
Pour the sauce over the salmon and bake for 10-14 minutes until the fish is tender and flaky. You can grill on low for the last few minutes to thicken the sauce, watching closely.
Rest the salmon for a few minutes so the sauce thickens, then serve.

title: Yaki Udon
description: Stir-fried udon with pork belly, onion, cabbage, carrot and shiitake, seasoned with mentsuyu and soy sauce and topped with bonito flakes.

ingredients.name: cabbage
ingredients.note: 2–3 leaves, cored and cut into 2.5 cm squares; weight from the creator's page

ingredients.name: spring onion
ingredients.note: 2 stalks; green tops sliced to top the dish, the rest cut into 5 cm pieces

ingredients.name: pork belly
ingredients.note: sliced into 2.5 cm pieces, or other meat

steps.text: Prep the vegetables: slice the onion, cut the cabbage into squares, julienne the carrot, slice the shiitake and cut the scallions, keeping the green tops for garnish. Slice the pork belly.
Boil the udon, drain and rinse under cold water.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and stir-fry the pork.
Add the onion and cook until soft, then add the carrot and cabbage.
Add the scallion pieces, shiitake and pepper, and stir-fry until the vegetables are lightly wilted.
Add the udon, mentsuyu and soy sauce and mix well.
Plate and top with bonito flakes and the scallion greens.

title: Beef Lo Mein
description: Velvety marinated sliced beef and onion tossed with egg noodles, scallion, oyster sauce and soy sauces in a very hot wok, with the heat off for the final mixing.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.note: sliced 3 mm thick; chuck, flank, ribeye or sirloin

ingredients.name: shaoxing wine
ingredients.note: Chinese cooking wine, for the marinade

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.note: freshly ground, to taste, for the marinade

steps.text: Slice the beef thinly and mix with the salt, baking soda, soy sauce, cooking wine, cornstarch and black pepper. Leave for 20 minutes.
Boil the fresh egg noodles for 2-3 minutes (or per the packet), then drain and shake off the excess water.
Heat the wok on maximum until smoking, add the oil generously and swirl it. When the oil smokes again, add the beef and stir-fry.
When the beef is about halfway cooked with a little pink left, add the sliced onion and stir for another 15 seconds.
Add the scallions and the drained noodles, then turn the heat off.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce and dark soy sauce and mix until evenly coated. Taste and adjust, and add a little toasted sesame oil at the end if you like.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
description: Marinated chicken part-fried then braised with dried chillies, ginger, garlic and onion in an oyster and dark soy gravy, finished with black vinegar and sesame oil.

ingredients.name: cornflour
ingredients.note: or tapioca flour, for the marinade

ingredients.name: shaoxing wine
ingredients.note: Chinese cooking wine or Huatiao wine

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: to taste, added near the end

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: 1–2, for frying the aromatics, plus oil for the chicken

steps.text: Marinate the chicken with the oyster sauce, light soy, cornflour and white pepper for about 20 minutes.
Mix the gravy: water, dark soy sauce and oyster sauce. Set aside.
Fry the chicken pieces in hot oil without stirring at first, until about 70% done and lightly browned. Remove.
In a pan with 1-2 tbsp oil, fry the ginger, then add the dried chillies, chilli padi, garlic, onion and Sichuan peppercorns for a few minutes until fragrant.
Return the chicken, pour in the gravy, add the white part of the spring onion and the sugar, cover and cook for about 10 minutes.
Taste and add a little salt, then stir in the black vinegar, sesame oil, cooking wine and the green spring onion, and serve.

title: Ma Po Tofu
description: Diced firm tofu simmered with stir-fried pork, doubanjiang and sweet bean sauce, thickened with potato starch and finished with garlic chives.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.note: firm, drained 20 minutes and cut in 3/4 inch cubes

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.note: cut into fine strips then chopped

ingredients.name: chives
ingredients.note: garlic chives (nira), cut in half inch pieces

ingredients.name: chicken stock
ingredients.note: Chinese-style granulated, dissolved in the hot water

ingredients.name: sake
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp with the pork, 1 tbsp with the stock

ingredients.name: rice
ingredients.note: steamed, to serve (the video's list has steamed rice with millet)

steps.text: Wrap the tofu in a thick paper towel, weigh it down with a dish and drain it for 20 minutes.
Chop the garlic, cut the ginger into fine strips and chop them, and cut the garlic chives into half-inch pieces.
Dissolve the chicken stock granules in 150 ml hot water. Dissolve the potato starch in twice its volume of water.
Halve the drained tofu horizontally, then cut it into 3/4 inch cubes.
Heat the sesame oil and stir-fry the pork over high heat, breaking it up, until fully cooked. Add the garlic and ginger on medium heat and fry until fragrant.

Push the pork aside and fry the doubanjiang and sweet bean sauce on the hot pan surface over low heat, stirring constantly. Mix them through the pork, then add 1 tbsp sake and stir until the moisture is gone.
Add the stock, soy sauce and 1 tbsp sake. Add the tofu, bring to the boil on high, then simmer on medium-low for 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in the garlic chives. Lift the pan off the heat, pour in the starch mixture while swirling, and mix gently so the tofu doesn't break.
Heat on high for about 30 seconds until thickened, then serve with Sichuan pepper, on its own or over rice.

title: Chicken Fried Rice
description: Soy sauce chicken fried rice: marinated diced chicken, egg, carrot and peas stir-fried with garlic and cooked rice, seasoned with dark soy sauce and finished with spring onion.

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.note: or thigh, cut into strips then large dice

steps.text: Mince the garlic, chop the spring onions, finely dice the carrot and cut the chicken into strips, then large dice.
Mix the marinade seasonings into the chicken, then stir in the 2 tsp oil last.
For the rice, use freshly cooked jasmine rice made with 1 cup rice to 1 cup water and a few drops of oil, so it is not too soft. If you use leftover rice, warm it in the microwave first.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat with a little oil. Stir-fry the eggs until golden and set them aside.
Add a little oil, spread the chicken in the hot pan and let it fry briefly without stirring. Add the garlic and stir-fry until 70 to 80 percent cooked.
Add the carrot until coated with oil, then the peas for about 30 seconds. Remove the chicken and vegetables from the pan.
Add a little more oil and the warm rice, breaking up clumps. Add the eggs, season with the salt and mix.
Add the dark soy sauce half at a time onto the hot pan surface, then stir-fry until the colour is even.
Return the chicken, carrot and peas, mix, then stir in the spring onion.

title: Wontons
description: Crispy deep-fried pork wontons filled with minced shiitake, cilantro stems, scallion and oyster sauce, served with a homemade sweet and sour dipping sauce. Makes about 36 wontons.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for the sweet and sour sauce

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: extra light olive oil in the video (cooking oil on the written page), for deep-frying

steps.text: Simmer the 1 cup water, rice vinegar, ketchup, sugar and salt in a saucepan. Stir in the cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water and stir until thickened, then set aside.
Mix the ground pork, minced shiitake, cilantro stems, scallion, soy sauce, oyster sauce, Shaoxing wine, sesame oil, salt, white pepper and eggs until smooth, without over-mixing.
Brush the edges of a wrapper with water, put 1 teaspoon of filling in the middle, fold into a triangle and seal, pressing out air.
Wet one bottom corner and pinch the two bottom corners together. Repeat with the remaining wrappers.
Heat the oil in a large pot to about 163°C. Fry the wontons in small batches, turning now and then, for about 5 minutes until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with the sweet and sour sauce.

title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: Thinly sliced beef marinated in soy, oyster sauce and cornstarch, stir-fried with garlic, then tossed with quickly cooked ginger broccoli in a soy and oyster sauce that thickens in the pan.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: beef marinade, mixed in after the other marinade ingredients

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: for frying the broccoli and beef

ingredients.name: shaoxing wine
ingredients.note: rice wine (cooking wine), for the beef

steps.text: Mince the garlic, cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the ginger. Slice the beef thinly across the grain.
Marinate the beef with the soy sauce, dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, sugar, baking soda, pepper, cornstarch and water, mixing until the water is absorbed. Then mix in a little oil.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat with a little oil, sizzle the ginger briefly, and stir-fry the broccoli until coated. Add the wine and cook it off, then season with salt and sugar.
Add the 1/3 cup water, cover and cook the broccoli for 30 seconds. Take it out of the pan.
Add a little more oil and spread the beef in the pan. Pan-fry one side, add the garlic, then turn the beef.
When the beef is about half cooked, add the wine and stir-fry until it evaporates. Add the dark soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar and stir-fry until the colour is even.
Add the water and cook until the sauce thickens. Turn off the heat, return the broccoli, add more black pepper and mix.

title: Beef pho
description: Vietnamese beef noodle soup: a spiced broth simmered for hours from beef bones and brisket, poured over rice noodles and raw sliced beef, with herbs, lime and chilli.

ingredients.name: beef brisket
ingredients.note: for the broth; 3-5 slices go in each bowl

ingredients.name: beef marrow bones
ingredients.note: leg or knuckle, cut to show the marrow

ingredients.name: beef fillet
ingredients.note: tenderloin, raw, very thinly sliced; 30 g per bowl x 6

ingredients.name: basil
ingredients.note: Thai basil, 3-5 sprigs, topping on the side (essential)

ingredients.name: coriander
ingredients.note: 3-5 sprigs, topping on the side; or more basil

ingredients.name: chilli
ingredients.note: red, finely sliced, to serve, optional

steps.text: Heat a heavy dry skillet over high heat until smoking. Char the onions and ginger cut side down for a few minutes, then turn and set aside. Lightly toast the spices in a dry skillet over medium-high heat for 3 minutes.
Rinse the bones and brisket, put them in a large stock pot and cover with water. Boil for 5 minutes, drain, then rinse each piece under the tap.
Wipe out the pot and bring the 3.5 litres water to the boil. Add the bones, brisket, charred onion and ginger, spices, sugar and salt, so the water barely covers them.
Cover and simmer for 3 hours. Take out the brisket, cool it and refrigerate it for the bowls.
Simmer the remaining broth uncovered for 40 minutes, then strain, discarding bones and spices. You should have about 2.5 litres; if there is much more, reduce it.
Stir in the fish sauce and adjust the salt and sugar until the broth is beefy, fragrant and barely sweet.
Cook the rice noodles per the packet just before serving. Put noodles in each bowl and top with the raw beef and 3-5 slices of the cooked brisket.
Ladle about 400 ml very hot broth into each bowl to cook the beef to medium rare. Serve with the toppings on the side.

title: King prawn laksa
description: A quick Thai red curry paste and coconut broth with king prawns and rice noodles, finished with lime and coriander.

ingredients.name: thai red curry paste
ingredients.note: the cook says 2 and a half tablespoons in the video

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.note: 400 ml, reduced fat or full fat

steps.text: Heat a medium pan and chop the small red chilli.
Add the coconut oil, then the chilli and the Thai red curry paste, and cook the paste off briefly until it warms through.
Pour in the vegetable stock and bring it up to heat.
Add the can of coconut milk and the fish sauce, then squeeze in the juice of one lime and let it bubble.
Add the king prawns and the precooked rice noodles and cook until the prawns are just cooked through.
Finish with roughly chopped coriander scattered over the top. The whole dish takes about 5 to 6 minutes.

title: Nasi lemak
description: Coconut milk rice served with spicy anchovy sambal, spiced fried chicken, hard-boiled eggs, cucumber and peanuts.

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.note: for the chicken paste; recipe says 1/2 inch

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.note: large, lightly beaten, to coat the chicken

ingredients.name: dried anchovies
ingredients.note: dried anchovies (ikan bilis), for the sambal; not tinned fillets

ingredients.name: dried chillies
ingredients.note: cut small, seeds removed, for the sambal

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.note: for the sambal; recipe says 1/2 inch

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: for frying the chicken, anchovies and onion; amount not given

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: a splash to loosen the sambal paste, and for soaking the rice; amount not given

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.note: matchsticks, for the rice; recipe says 2 inch

ingredients.name: lemongrass
ingredients.note: cut in 2 inch lengths, for the rice

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.note: hard-boiled, to serve; amount not given

steps.text: Soak the basmati rice in water for 30 minutes, then drain it just before using.
Pound or blend the lemongrass, garlic and ginger to a paste. Marinate the chicken with it and the remaining chicken spices, salt, sugar and coconut milk for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Coat the marinated chicken with the beaten egg and rice flour. Fry in hot oil on medium heat until golden and cooked through, then drain on paper towel.
For the sambal, blend the chilli, shallots, garlic, shrimp paste and ginger with a splash of water into a paste.
Fry the anchovies in oil until crisp and set aside. Fry the sliced onions until soft and golden at the edges and set aside.
Cook the blended chilli paste with a splash of water for 15-20 minutes, stirring now and then, until reduced and thick.
Season the sambal with salt, sugar and tamarind juice to a balance of sweet, sour and salty. Stir in the fried anchovies and onion and turn off the heat.
For the rice, bring the coconut milk, water, pandan, shallot, ginger, garlic, lemongrass and salt to the boil. Add the drained rice and return to a simmer.
Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes, then rest off the heat for 10 minutes and fluff.
Serve the rice with the sambal, fried chicken, hard-boiled eggs, cucumber slices and peanuts.

title: Beef Rendang
description: Beef chuck cooked uncovered for about four hours in a blended shallot, ginger and chilli paste with coconut milk, tamarind and lemongrass until the sauce reduces into the meat.

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.note: peeled and sliced; recipe says 1.5 inch piece

ingredients.name: galangal
ingredients.note: or use more ginger; recipe says 1.5 inch piece

ingredients.name: chuck steak
ingredients.note: chuck, cut in 2 inch (5 cm) pieces

ingredients.name: lemongrass
ingredients.note: stalk, lighter part, bruised and cut in pieces

ingredients.name: coconut milk
ingredients.note: full fat; can size not stated

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: to rinse the coconut milk can, plus more as needed

steps.text: Cut the beef into 2 inch pieces and set aside.
Blitz the shallots, garlic, ginger, galangal, chillies, salt, chilli flakes, coriander, turmeric, cardamom and nutmeg in a food processor until finely ground.
Cook the paste in the oil in a large saute pan over medium heat for 7 to 8 minutes, until most of the moisture has gone. A little browning is fine.
Add the beef without browning it, then the coconut milk, tamarind and brown sugar. Rinse the coconut milk can with water and add that too.
Bring to a simmer on medium-high. Bruise the lemongrass with the back of a knife, cut it in pieces and add it.

Cook uncovered on about medium heat for around 4 hours, stirring more often as it thickens, until the liquid has reduced into the beef and the meat is fork tender. Add water if it dries out before the beef is tender, or raise the heat if there is too much liquid when the beef is ready.
Serve with steamed rice, topped with chopped coriander and a squeeze of fresh lime. It improves if rested overnight in the fridge.

title: Chicken handi
description: Chicken thigh curry cooked in a wok with dark-fried onions, tomato, whole spices, yoghurt, dried fenugreek and a little cream.

ingredients.name: coriander seeds
ingredients.note: crushed; added in two lots, with the cumin and with the yoghurt

ingredients.name: green chilli
ingredients.note: 3-4; the video also garnishes with a few

ingredients.name: cream
ingredients.note: optional in the written list; the video adds it

steps.text: Melt the ghee in a wok or pan over high heat and fry the sliced onions until dark golden brown, almost burnt. Remove them to a bowl, leaving the ghee in the pan.
In the same ghee, saute the chopped garlic, then add the tomatoes and cook until soft.
Return the fried onions and add the ginger paste, cumin, crushed coriander seeds and green chillies.
Stir in the turmeric, salt and chilli powder, then add the chicken and fry until almost cooked.
Cover and steam for about 5 minutes, until the ghee separates from the masala and coats the chicken.
Add the beaten yoghurt, a few more crushed coriander seeds and the dried fenugreek and stir well.
Pour in the cream, add a little more fenugreek and the garam masala, give a final stir and garnish with green chillies.

title: Tandoori chicken
description: Chicken marinated in yoghurt, garlic, ginger and ground spices, baked on a rack and basted until charred, served with a mint yoghurt.

ingredients.name: yoghurt
ingredients.note: plain, full fat, for the marinade

ingredients.name: ground cumin
ingredients.note: listed as "2 tsp cumin" among the ground spices

ingredients.name: chilli powder
ingredients.note: pure chilli powder, adjust to taste

ingredients.name: chicken drumsticks
ingredients.note: or bone-in skin-on thighs / whole legs

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: oil spray, for greasing: sprayed over the chicken before the final bake; amount not given

ingredients.name: yoghurt
ingredients.note: plain, for the mint yoghurt, to serve

ingredients.name: mint
ingredients.note: leaves, packed, for the mint yoghurt, to serve

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: to taste, for the mint yoghurt, to serve

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.note: to taste, for the mint yoghurt, to serve

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: for the mint yoghurt, to serve; amount not given

ingredients.name: basmati rice
ingredients.note: to serve, or saffron rice (recipe notes)

steps.text: Mix the marinade ingredients in a large bowl, add the chicken, cover and marinate for 12-24 hours.
Heat the oven to 180°C and line a tray with foil topped with a rack.
Lift the chicken out of the marinade, shaking off the excess, keep the marinade, and place the chicken on the rack. Bake for 20 minutes.
Spread the reserved marinade generously over both sides and bake another 10 minutes, then dab more marinade on top.
Bake a further 10 minutes, baste once more and spray with oil.
Raise the oven to 220°C and bake 10-15 minutes more until there are charred spots.

For the optional mint yoghurt, blitz the yoghurt, mint, salt, pepper and olive oil in a food processor until the mint is very finely chopped. Serve the chicken with the mint yoghurt and basmati or saffron rice.

title: Dal fry
description: Pressure-cooked tuvar and moong dal simmered in an onion and ginger tempering, finished with a second garlic and Kashmiri chilli tadka.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: to taste, in the dal and tempering

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.note: 1 inch, finely chopped, for the tempering

ingredients.name: chilli powder
ingredients.note: Kashmiri red, for the second tempering

steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a pressure cooker, add the soaked tuvar and moong dal and roast for 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced ginger, salt, turmeric, red chilli powder and green chilli and mix well.
Add 1 1/2 cups water, cover and cook for 3 whistles.
Meanwhile heat ghee and oil in a pan and saute the cumin, ginger and garlic until fragrant. Add the onion and cook until translucent.
Add the chilli powder, turmeric and salt and cook 2-3 minutes until the raw spice smell is gone.
Add the cooked dal to this tempering and simmer for 3-4 minutes.
For the second tempering, heat the ghee and oil with a little water in a pan. Add the sliced garlic, whole red chillies, asafoetida and Kashmiri chilli powder and cook until it splutters.
Pour the dal into a serving dish, garnish with coriander and pour the tempering over to serve hot.

title: Lamb rogan josh
description: Lamb marinated in yoghurt, saffron and ginger-garlic paste, cooked with pounded whole spices and browned onions, then powdered spices and tomato puree.

ingredients.name: ginger garlic paste
ingredients.note: for the marinade; bought, or made by blitzing equal weights of peeled ginger and garlic with a little water and oil

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: to taste, for the marinade; the video also adds a pinch to the onions

ingredients.name: coriander
ingredients.note: fresh leaves, finely chopped, to garnish

ingredients.name: ginger
ingredients.note: fresh, peeled and julienned, to garnish

steps.text: Whisk the yoghurt, saffron and ginger-garlic paste with salt and pour over the lamb. Cover and marinate in the fridge for 2 hours, then bring to room temperature before cooking.
Pound the cumin, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves and star anise in a mortar to release their oils.
Heat the oil in a heavy pan, add the pounded spices and stir until they crackle.
Add the sliced onions straight away so the spices don't burn, with a pinch of salt to draw out their moisture, and cook until golden to deep brown.
Add the lamb with its marinade and cook until browned but not cooked through, scraping the pan. Add a splash of water or lamb stock if it gets too dry.
Add the nutmeg, pepper, chilli, coriander, garam masala and turmeric and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato puree and cook until the lamb is cooked through. Garnish with chopped coriander and ginger shreds.

title: Matar Paneer
description: Sweet peas and paneer in a gently spiced tomato gravy.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a frying pan over high heat until it’s shimmering hot. Add the paneer, then turn the heat down a little.

Fry until it starts to brown at the edges, then turn it over and brown on each side – the paneer will brown faster than you think, so don’t walk away. Remove the paneer from the pan and drain on kitchen paper.

Put the ginger, cumin, turmeric, ground coriander and chilli in the pan, and fry everything for 1 min. Add the tomatoes, mashing them with the back of a spoon and simmer everything for 5 mins until the sauce smells fragrant.
Add a splash of water if it’s too thick. Season well. Add the peas and simmer for a further 2 mins, then stir in the paneer and sprinkle over the garam masala.
Divide between two bowls, top with coriander leaves and serve with naan bread, roti or rice.

title: Kidney Bean Curry
description: Rajma masala: kidney beans pressure-cooked, then simmered in an onion, tomato, ginger-garlic and spice masala and garnished with coriander.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: to taste, in the beans and in the masala

ingredients.name: rajma masala
ingredients.note: spice mix from an Indian grocery

ingredients.name: asafoetida
ingredients.note: added to the beans; transcript spells it 'esapa', taken to be asafoetida (hing)

steps.text: Boil the soaked, drained kidney beans in 4 cups of fresh water in a pressure cooker with salt and a pinch of asafoetida for about three whistles. Lower the heat and cook another 15 to 20 minutes until soft.
Heat the oil in a pan and add the cumin seeds until they sizzle.
Add the onion paste with the ginger and garlic paste and saute until the onion is golden brown.
Add the tomato puree and green chilli with a little salt, and cook for 6 to 7 minutes until the paste is thick and the oil separates.
Add the garam masala, rajma masala, coriander, paprika and turmeric, then 1/4 cup water, and cook for 30 to 40 seconds.
Add the cooked kidney beans and cook in the masala for 7 to 8 minutes.
Garnish with coriander and serve with roti, chapati, naan or rice.

title: Spaghetti alla Carbonara
description: Spaghetti tossed off the heat with crisp guanciale and a cream of egg yolks, pecorino romano and black pepper, with no cream added.

ingredients.name: pecorino
ingredients.note: pecorino romano; keep some back to serve

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: for the pasta water, to taste

steps.text: Put a pot of salted water on to boil. Remove the rind from the guanciale and cut it into slices, then into strips.
Brown the guanciale in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat for about 10 minutes without letting it burn.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in the boiling water until al dente.
Whisk the egg yolks with most of the pecorino and black pepper to a smooth cream, keeping a little pecorino back for serving.
Turn off the heat, lift the guanciale out with a slotted spoon and set it aside, leaving the fat in the pan. Add a ladleful of pasta water to the fat.
Drain the spaghetti straight into the pan and toss briefly. Take the pan off the heat and quickly mix in the egg and pecorino cream, adding a little pasta water if needed to make it creamy.
Return the guanciale, mix once more and serve immediately with the remaining pecorino and a pinch of black pepper.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: A beef bolognese sauce simmered with red wine, tomato and herbs, tossed through spaghetti with a little pasta water and finished with parmesan.

ingredients.name: red wine
ingredients.note: dry; water or stock can replace it

ingredients.name: thyme
ingredients.note: fresh, or 1/2 tsp dried thyme or oregano

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: cooking salt, plus more to taste

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large pot or deep skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the onion and garlic for 3 minutes until light golden and soft.
Turn the heat to high, add the beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned.
Pour in the red wine and simmer for 1 minute, scraping the base of the pot, until the alcohol smell has gone.

Add the stock cubes, tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, bay leaves, thyme, salt and pepper. Bring to a simmer, then turn down to medium and cook uncovered for 20-30 minutes, stirring now and then and adding water if it gets too thick.
Optional slow version: add 3/4 cup water, cover and simmer very gently for 2-2.5 hours, stirring every 30 minutes, then uncover and simmer 20 minutes to thicken.
Taste the sauce and add more salt if needed. Boil the spaghetti in salted water for 1 minute less than the packet says. Keep a mugful of the cooking water, then drain.

Tip the pasta into the sauce with about 1/2 cup (125 ml) of the reserved water over medium heat. Toss gently for 1.5-2 minutes until the spaghetti turns red and the sauce thickens. (Tossing is optional: you can simply serve the sauce over the spaghetti.)
Divide between bowls and finish with parmesan and a little parsley if you like.

title: Lasagne
description: Baked lasagne with a beef, veal and sausage bolognese, a ricotta and parmesan filling and mozzarella on top.

ingredients.name: beef mince
ingredients.note: half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: veal
ingredients.note: ground, half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: sausages
ingredients.note: pork, removed from casing, half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas; plus extra to toss the noodles (amount not stated)

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.note: medium, chopped; half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: finely chopped; half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: celery
ingredients.note: finely chopped; half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: carrot
ingredients.note: peeled, finely chopped; half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: tomato puree
ingredients.note: tomato paste, half of a 6 oz (170 g) can; half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: canned tomatoes
ingredients.note: crushed, one 28 oz can (half of the two cans); half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: red wine
ingredients.note: half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: beef stock
ingredients.note: half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: bay leaf
ingredients.note: dried; half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: basil
ingredients.note: fresh chopped, or 1 tsp dried; half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: to taste, for the sauce and filling

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.note: half of the sauce batch, which makes two lasagnas

ingredients.name: parmesan
ingredients.note: grated, for the filling, plus extra to sprinkle

steps.text: Make the sauce: heat the oil in a pot, brown the sausage until crumbled, then add the beef and veal and brown them chunky with salt and pepper. (The creator's sauce makes two lasagnas; the amounts here are half, for the one lasagna assembled below.)
Add the onion, garlic, celery and carrot and saute for 3-4 minutes until soft.

Turn up the heat, add the wine and scrape the pan, simmer 2 minutes, then add the stock, tomatoes, tomato paste, basil, bay leaves, sugar and chilli flakes if using. Simmer uncovered on low for about 1 hour until thick.
Meanwhile heat the oven to 175 C. Boil the noodles about 5 minutes until al dente, drain, rinse cold and toss with a little olive oil.
Mix the ricotta, parmesan, parsley and eggs with a little salt and pepper.

In a greased 9x13 inch dish layer sauce, noodles, half the ricotta, a third of the mozzarella and some parmesan. Repeat with sauce, noodles in the opposite direction, the remaining ricotta, another third of the mozzarella and parmesan.
Finish with sauce, a final layer of noodles, more sauce and a sprinkle of parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake about 40 minutes until hot and bubbling.
Uncover, add the remaining mozzarella and bake 10-15 minutes more until melted and browned. Cool 20-30 minutes before slicing.

title: Fettuccine Alfredo
description: Fettuccine in a quick sauce of butter, garlic, cream and Parmesan, loosened with a little of the pasta water.

ingredients.name: parmesan
ingredients.note: freshly grated, plus more to serve

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: plus salt for the pasta water

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil over medium-high heat. Cook the fettuccine to the packet directions, reserve 1/4 cup of the pasta water, then drain well.
While the pasta cooks, melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Stir in the cream and cook, stirring often, until warm and bubbling, about 1 minute.

Whisk in the Parmesan, pepper and salt until the cheese melts and the sauce is smooth. Keep whisking now and then until it thickens slightly, 1 to 2 minutes. If the pasta isn't ready, turn the heat to low to hold the sauce.
Add the drained pasta and toss to coat. Stir in the reserved pasta water 1 tablespoon at a time until the sauce is the consistency you like.
Serve straight away, with extra Parmesan and black pepper if you like, as the sauce keeps thickening as it sits.

title: Spicy arrabiata penne
description: Penne in a very garlicky, chilli-spiked tomato sauce with fennel seeds, red wine and basil, finished in the sauce with a little pasta water and served with Parmesan.

ingredients.name: canned tomatoes
ingredients.note: 28 oz (about 800 g) each, whole peeled San Marzano, drained

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: kosher, in the sauce; plus 2 tbsp for the pasta water

ingredients.name: basil
ingredients.note: fresh leaves, julienned, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Blanch the garlic cloves in boiling water for about 15 seconds so the skins slip off, then peel them.
Warm the olive oil in a medium pot or Dutch oven over medium-low heat. Add the whole garlic cloves and cook for 10 to 12 minutes, tossing now and then, until softened and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, drain the tomatoes and pulse them in a food processor until roughly chopped. Lift the garlic out with a slotted spoon and pulse it in the processor too.
Tip the tomato mixture into the pot with the oil. Add the fennel seeds, chilli flakes, red wine, 1 tbsp salt and 1 tsp black pepper. Bring to the boil, lower the heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the basil, taste for seasoning (it will be very spicy) and keep the sauce warm over very low heat.
Meanwhile bring a large pot of water to a full boil, add 2 tbsp kosher salt and cook the penne to the packet directions.
Two minutes before the pasta is al dente, lift it out with a strainer into the sauce along with 1/4 cup of the pasta water. Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until al dente.
Spoon into shallow bowls and serve hot, topped with extra basil and grated Parmesan.

title: Chilli prawn linguine
description: Linguine tossed with quickly pan-fried prawns, garlic, fresh red chilli, butter and rocket, served with a lemon wedge.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: for the pasta water and to season the prawns

steps.text: Cook the linguine in a pan of boiling salted water for 8 to 10 minutes, or to your taste.
While the pasta cooks, heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat. Add the prawns, season with salt and pepper, and shake the pan to turn them. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the garlic and chilli, shake the pan to mix and cook for a further minute.
Add the butter and shake the pan until it has melted and coats the prawns, then take the pan off the heat.
Drain the linguine well in a colander and leave it to rest.
Put the prawns back on a low heat, add the rocket, stir it in and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the linguine to the prawns and rocket and toss carefully until well coated, then remove from the heat.
Serve with tongs, sharing the prawns between plates and decorating each with a lemon wedge.

title: Rigatoni with fennel sausage sauce
description: A rich sausage and fennel ragu clinging to big rigatoni tubes.

ingredients.name: fennel bulb
ingredients.note: trimmed and roughly chopped; reserve any fronds to garnish

ingredients.name: fennel seeds
ingredients.note: lightly toasted and then gently crushed

steps.text: Heat a tablespoon of oil in a large saute pan for which you have a lid. Add the sausage pieces and fry on a medium-high heat for 10 minutes, stirring regularly, until golden-brown all over.

Transfer the sausages to a plate, then add the onion and fennel to the hot pan and fry for 15 minutes, stirring once in a while, until soft and caramelised; if the pan goes a bit dry, add a teaspoon or so of extra oil.
Stir in the paprika, garlic and half the fennel seeds, fry for two minutes more, then pour on the wine and boil for 30 seconds, to reduce by half.
Add the tomatoes, sugar, 100ml water, the seared sausage and half a teaspoon of salt, cover and simmer for 30 minutes; remove the lid after 10 minutes, and cook until the sauce is thick and rich.
Remove from the heat, stir through the olives and remaining fennel seeds and set aside until you’re ready to serve.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, add the pasta and cook for 12-14 minutes (or according to the instructions on the packet), until al dente. Meanwhile, reheat the sauce.
Drain the pasta, return it to the pot, stir in a tablespoon of oil, then divide between the bowls.
Put all the pesto ingredients except the basil in the small bowl of a food processor. Add a tablespoon of water and blitz to a rough paste.
Add the basil, then blitz until just combined (the pesto has a much better texture if the basil is not overblended).
Spoon over the ragù and top with a spoonful of pesto. Finish with a sprinkling of chopped fennel fronds, if you have any, and serve at once.

title: Salmon and prawn risotto
description: Risotto made with poached salmon and prawns, finished with butter, parsley and a squeeze of lemon, with optional strips of smoked salmon on top.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.note: half to sauté, half stirred in at the end

ingredients.name: shallot
ingredients.note: medium, chopped (or half a mild onion)

ingredients.name: vegetable stock
ingredients.note: about 1 litre, hot; vegetable or fish stock (the method tops the poaching water up to 1.25 l in total with stock)

ingredients.name: smoked salmon
ingredients.note: 2–3 slices, cut into thin strips, optional, to serve

steps.text: Fill a wide pan with about 2 cm of boiling water, add the salmon fillets in one layer and poach for 10 minutes. Cover, take off the heat and set aside.
Melt 25 g of the butter in a large pan and soften the chopped shallot for about 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice for a minute or two, then add the white wine and cook until it is absorbed.
Lift the salmon out of its poaching water, make the water up to 1.25 litres with stock, and keep it warm over a low heat.
Add the stock to the rice a ladleful at a time over a low heat, stirring until each is absorbed, until most of the stock is in and the rice is almost tender.
Flake in the salmon in large chunks, discarding skin and bones, and add the prawns and the last of the stock. Cook gently, stirring, until the stock is absorbed and the fish is piping hot.
Off the heat, stir in the remaining 25 g butter, cover and rest for 2 minutes. Season to taste.
Serve with parsley, a squeeze of lemon and smoked salmon strips if using.

title: Margherita pizza
description: A thin, crisp margherita made from scratch at home.

steps.text: 1 Preheat the oven to 230°C.
2 Add the sugar and crumble the fresh yeast into warm water.
3 Allow the mixture to stand for 10 – 15 minutes in a warm place (we find a windowsill on a sunny day works best) until froth develops on the surface.
4 Sift the flour and salt into a large mixing bowl, make a well in the middle and pour in the yeast mixture and olive oil.
5 Lightly flour your hands, and slowly mix the ingredients together until they bind.
6 Generously dust your surface with flour.
7 Throw down the dough and begin kneading for 10 minutes until smooth, silky and soft. )
9 Spread the passata on top making sure you go to the edge.
10 Evenly place the mozzarella (or other cheese) on top, season with the oregano and black pepper, then drizzle with a little olive oil.
11 Cook in the oven for 10 – 12 minutes until the cheese slightly colours.
12 When ready, place the basil leaf on top and tuck in!

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato, capsicum and red onion sauce, finished with fresh coriander or parsley and served with crusty bread.

ingredients.name: capsicum
ingredients.note: small red capsicum, halved and sliced into 0.5 cm strips

ingredients.name: vegetable stock
ingredients.note: chicken or vegetable broth, or water

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper
ingredients.note: or other hot spice, to taste

ingredients.name: coriander
ingredients.note: fresh, roughly chopped; or parsley; to garnish

ingredients.name: bread
ingredients.note: crusty bread or pita, to serve

steps.text: If baking the eggs, preheat the oven to 180°C. Heat the oil in a medium cast iron skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the garlic and onion for 2 minutes until the onion is translucent.
Add the capsicum and cook 1 minute, then add the diced tomato and cook about 2 minutes until it breaks down into a paste.
Stir in the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, paprika, cumin, salt, black pepper and cayenne.
Lower to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick enough to hold indentations but still saucy.
Make hollows in the sauce, crack in the eggs and leave for 1 minute until the edges of the whites set.
Finish by baking at 180°C for 7 to 12 minutes, or cover and steam on the stove for 3 minutes for runny yolks, until the whites are set.
Scatter with coriander or parsley and serve immediately with crusty bread or pita.

title: Moussaka
description: Fried potato and aubergine slices layered with a cinnamon-spiced beef and tomato sauce under a thick parmesan béchamel, then baked until golden.

ingredients.name: aubergine
ingredients.note: medium to large, sliced 1 cm thick

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: for frying the aubergine and potato

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: for the meat sauce, plus extra for salting the aubergines and a pinch for the béchamel

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.note: for the meat sauce, plus a little for the béchamel

ingredients.name: beef stock
ingredients.note: beef broth; or use 1/2 cup red wine instead

ingredients.name: parmesan
ingredients.note: for the béchamel, plus a little grated over the top

steps.text: Slice the aubergines 1 cm thick, season with salt and set aside for 30 minutes. Meanwhile peel and slice the potatoes.

Rinse the aubergines well and pat dry. Fry the aubergine and potato slices in vegetable oil until golden and drain on paper towels. For a lighter version, drizzle them with olive oil and bake until golden instead.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Sauté the chopped onion for 3–4 minutes, then add the crushed garlic and cook 2–3 minutes more.

Add the beef and cook, stirring, until no longer pink. Stir in the salt, pepper, cinnamon and thyme, then the tomato paste, bay leaf and tomato sauce. Add the broth, bring to the boil, then simmer on low until thickened. Set aside.
For the béchamel, warm the milk. Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat, whisk in the flour to a smooth paste, then gradually whisk in the warm milk until the sauce is smooth and thick.
Take the béchamel off the heat and whisk in a pinch of salt, some black pepper, the nutmeg, parmesan and egg yolks until smooth. Heat the oven to 180°C.

Stir 4–5 tbsp of the béchamel into the meat sauce. In a 33 × 22 cm ovenproof dish, layer the potatoes, then half the aubergines, then spread over the meat. Top with the rest of the aubergines, pour over the béchamel and grate some parmesan on top.
Bake for 40–50 minutes until golden brown. Let it cool for at least 45 minutes before cutting.

title: Chicken Quinoa Greek Salad
description: Shawarma-spiced lemon-garlic chicken grilled and sliced over quinoa, mixed greens, tomatoes, cucumber, olives, corn, raisins, pistachios and feta, with a lemon vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: extra virgin, blended into the marinade

steps.text: Blend the 1 cup olive oil, 1/4 cup lemon juice, the 10 garlic cloves and 1/2 tsp salt until creamy and light yellow.
Coat the chicken in the shawarma seasoning and the blended marinade, cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes.
Boil the quinoa with the 1/2 cup water, then cover on low heat for 15 to 18 minutes until the water is absorbed.
Whisk the vinaigrette from the oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt and pepper and set aside.
Grill the chicken in a stovetop grill pan over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes a side until it reaches 74°C inside.
Rest the chicken for 5 minutes before slicing.
Combine the greens, corn, quinoa, tomatoes, cucumber, onion, olives, raisins and pistachios, then top with sliced chicken, feta and a drizzle of vinaigrette.

title: Lamb and Lemon Souvlaki
description: Cubes of lamb leg marinated in garlic, lemon, oregano, bay and white wine vinegar, threaded on skewers and seared, served in pita with tzatziki and Greek salad. Makes 12 skewers.

ingredients.name: bay leaf
ingredients.note: fresh, crushed in the hand (or 2 dried, kept whole)

ingredients.name: white wine vinegar
ingredients.note: or apple cider, sherry or red wine vinegar

ingredients.name: lamb leg
ingredients.note: boneless, fat trimmed, cut into 2.5 cm cubes (about 900 g after trimming)

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: cooking/kosher salt, to season the skewers

ingredients.name: greek salad
ingredients.note: chopped small, or shredded lettuce and tomato slices, to serve

ingredients.name: greek lemon rice
ingredients.note: optional, to serve, for plates instead of pita wraps

steps.text: Mix the garlic, lemon juice and zest, oregano, bay leaves, vinegar, 3 tbsp olive oil and 1 tsp salt in a bowl. Add the lamb, toss to coat and marinate in the fridge for 12–24 hours.
If you'll cook on a barbecue, soak wooden or bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes so they don't burn.
Lift the lamb out of the marinade and thread 3–4 pieces onto each skewer to make 12 (or 5 pieces each for 8 larger skewers).

To cook on the stove, sprinkle the skewers with the remaining 1 tsp salt and the pepper. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large non-stick pan over high heat and cook half the skewers for 3 minutes, then turn and cook 3 minutes more until well seared (about 60°C inside for medium-rare). Keep warm under foil while you cook the rest.

To barbecue instead, preheat it to medium-high (a flat hotplate is safer for wooden skewers; use metal skewers on the grill side). Drizzle the skewers with the 1 tbsp oil, sprinkle both sides with the salt and pepper, and cook for 3 minutes a side.

Pile the souvlaki onto a platter and serve with warm pita, tzatziki (or hummus) and finely chopped Greek salad (or shredded lettuce and tomato) for wraps, or make plates with Greek lemon rice and Greek salad.

title: Falafel pita with tahini
description: Deep-fried falafel from soaked dried chickpeas, tucked into warm pitas with Greek salad, tzatziki, sumac onions, Indian mint sauce and a drizzle of tahini. Makes 12 half-pita sandwiches.

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.note: small, roughly chopped, for the falafel

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.note: large, thinly sliced, for the sumac onions

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.note: freshly squeezed, for the sumac onions

ingredients.name: red chilli flakes
ingredients.note: optional, to taste, for the sumac onions

ingredients.name: cucumber
ingredients.note: finely grated, squeezed dry, for the tzatziki

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: for the tzatziki, to taste, plus extra to sprinkle on the cucumber

ingredients.name: greek yoghurt
ingredients.note: whole milk (5% fat), for the tzatziki

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: extra virgin, for the salad dressing

ingredients.name: dill
ingredients.note: fresh, chopped, for the salad dressing

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: for the salad dressing, to taste

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.note: for the salad dressing, to taste

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.note: or sugar; optional, for the salad dressing

ingredients.name: cherry tomatoes
ingredients.note: grape tomatoes, halved, for the Greek salad

ingredients.name: cucumber
ingredients.note: mini, diced, for the Greek salad

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.note: small, sliced, for the Greek salad

ingredients.name: coriander
ingredients.note: fresh leaves, sliced, for the Greek salad

ingredients.name: black olives
ingredients.note: to garnish the Greek salad, if desired

ingredients.name: greek yoghurt
ingredients.note: whole milk, for the mint sauce

ingredients.name: coriander
ingredients.note: fresh leaves, for the mint sauce

ingredients.name: mint
ingredients.note: fresh leaves, for the mint sauce

ingredients.name: chilli
ingredients.note: fresh green, chopped, for the mint sauce; 2–3

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.note: freshly ground, for the mint sauce

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.note: for the mint sauce, to taste

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.note: for the mint sauce, to taste

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: for the mint sauce, to taste

ingredients.name: sesame seed
ingredients.note: toasted, mixed in just before frying

ingredients.name: baking powder
ingredients.note: mixed in with the sesame seeds just before frying

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: for deep-frying, at least 2.5 cm deep

steps.text: Cover the dried chickpeas and bicarbonate of soda with at least 5 cm of water and soak overnight. Drain and pat dry with a kitchen towel.

Pulse the chickpeas in a food processor with the onion, garlic, parsley, coriander leaves, cumin, ground coriander, pepper and salt, scraping down the sides, until finely minced but not puréed. It is ready when a pressed handful holds its shape.
Refrigerate the falafel mix for at least 15 minutes; it keeps for 2–3 days.
For the sumac onions, toss the sliced red onion with the parsley, lemon juice, sumac, salt and chilli flakes if using, then chill for at least 20 minutes.

For the tzatziki, sprinkle the grated cucumber with salt, leave it about 5 minutes, then squeeze and pat it very dry. Mix the yoghurt with the olive oil, garlic, dill and lemon juice, stir in the cucumber and chill.

For the Greek salad, whisk the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, dill, salt, pepper and honey if using. Toss with the halved tomatoes, diced cucumber, sliced onion, crumbled feta and coriander, adding black olives if you like.
For the mint sauce, blend the yoghurt, coriander, mint, chillies, cumin, ground coriander, garam masala, pepper, garlic, lemon juice, sugar and salt, then chill until needed.
Just before frying, mix the sesame seeds and baking powder into the cold falafel mix. Scoop portions with a small ice-cream scoop or a 1/4 cup measure and press them firmly into even balls.
Heat at least 2.5 cm of oil in a deep pan over medium-high heat to at least 175°C. Fry the falafel a few at a time, turning, until dark golden brown, then drain on paper towels.

Warm the pitas in a pan over medium heat, cut them in half and open the pockets. Layer in Greek salad, tzatziki and sumac onions, then 2–3 falafel (whole or smashed) and more salad, tzatziki and onions. Drizzle with the mint sauce and tahini and serve straight away.

title: Chicken shawarma
description: Chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic, onion and Middle Eastern spices, broiled on a rack and sliced, with a light yogurt and mayonnaise garlic sauce.

ingredients.name: pita bread
ingredients.note: lightly toasted, to serve; amount not stated

ingredients.name: lettuce
ingredients.note: shredded, to serve (about 1/4 cup salad per pita)

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the spices, olive oil, grated garlic and lemon juice, then mix in the sliced onion. Cover and marinate at least 30 minutes, or overnight in the fridge (then let it sit out for an hour before cooking).
Make the sauce by whisking the yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice and grated garlic. Taste and add salt if needed, then chill.
Set the broiler to high with the oven rack at its highest, and put a cooling rack on a baking tray.
Arrange the chicken and onions on the rack and broil for 16 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway, until the chicken reaches 74°C inside.

Instead of broiling you can grill the chicken over medium-high heat for about 20 minutes, flipping after 10, until it reaches 74°C. Either way, rest it for about 10 minutes, slice into strips and toss with the softened, caramelised onions.
Serve in toasted pitas spread with sauce and topped with lettuce, tomato, cucumber, onion and the chicken, or over a salad bowl, with more sauce.

title: Lamb tagine
description: Lamb shoulder browned and slow-cooked in the oven with a ras el hanout-style spice mix, tomato paste, stock and dried apricots, finished with lemon zest and served over couscous.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder
ingredients.note: boneless, stewing meat, trimmed of fat and cut in 3.5 cm cubes (about 1.6 kg before trimming)

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: kosher, for the lamb; plus 1/2 tsp in the spice mix

ingredients.name: fennel seeds
ingredients.note: ground (fennel powder), for the spice mix

ingredients.name: cayenne pepper
ingredients.note: less for a milder dish, for the spice mix

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160 C (fan). Mix all the spices in the spice mix (coriander, cumin, cardamom, turmeric, fennel, cayenne, cloves, ground ginger and 1/2 tsp salt) in a bowl and set aside.
Toss the lamb with 1 tsp salt and the pepper. Heat the oil in a large lidded oven-proof pot over high heat and brown the lamb in 3 batches, about 3 minutes each, then set aside in a bowl.
Turn the heat down to medium-high. Cook the onion and garlic for 3 minutes until soft.
Add the tomato paste, grated ginger, cinnamon sticks and the spice mix, and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 1/2 minutes.
Pour in the chicken stock and some water, stir, and return the lamb to the pot.
Bring to a simmer, cover and cook in the oven for 45 minutes.
Add the apricots, put the lid back on and cook for another hour. Check halfway that the sauce hasn't reduced too far, and add 1/2 cup water if it has.
Stir in the lemon zest once the lamb is tender. Serve over plain couscous, sprinkled with toasted almonds and coriander.

title: Koshari
description: Layered Egyptian rice dish: spiced basmati rice topped with macaroni, a cinnamon and tomato sauce, sprouted lentils, chickpeas and fried onions.

ingredients.name: nutmeg
ingredients.note: freshly grated, for the spice mix, to taste (no amount given)

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.note: freshly cracked, for the spice mix, to taste

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.note: for the sauce and the rice water, to taste

ingredients.name: passata
ingredients.note: fresh tomato puree (not concentrated paste), for the sauce

ingredients.name: fried onions
ingredients.note: fried and ready beforehand; the top layer

steps.text: Mix the cumin, chilli powder, sweet paprika, coriander powder, freshly grated nutmeg and cracked black pepper into a spice mix. Have the lentils, chickpeas, macaroni and fried onions cooked and ready.
Heat the olive oil for the sauce, add the cinnamon stick, bay leaf and grated garlic, then the chopped onion with a little salt. Cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the tomato puree and 2 tablespoons of the spice mix, and cook on medium-low heat for 7 to 8 minutes until the sauce is dry and thick.
For the rice, bring 2 cups of salted water and the rest of the spice mix to a boil in a stockpot. Add the soaked, washed basmati rice.
Return to a boil, cover and cook on low heat by absorption for at least 4 minutes, until the water is gone and the rice is cooked.
Swirl a tablespoon of olive oil through the rice and fluff it lightly without breaking the grains.
Layer on a platter: rice, then macaroni, then the tomato sauce with the cinnamon stick and bay leaf removed. Top with sprouted lentils, chickpeas and fried onions.

title: Chickpea Fajitas
description: Smoky spiced chickpeas and peppers wrapped in warm tortillas.

steps.text: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and line a baking tray with foil. Drain the chickpeas, pat dry and tip onto the prepared baking tray.
Add the oil and paprika, toss to coat, then roast for 20-25 mins until browned and crisp, shaking halfway through cooking.

Meanwhile, put the tomatoes and onion in a small bowl with the vinegar and set aside to pickle. Put the avocado in another bowl and mash with a fork, leaving some larger chunks. Stir in the lime juice and season well.
Mix the soured cream with the harissa and set aside until ready to serve.
Heat a griddle pan until nearly smoking. Add the tortillas , one at a time, charring each side until hot with griddle lines.

Put everything on the table and build the fajitas : spread a little of the harissa cream over the tortilla, top with roasted chickpeas, guacamole, pickled salsa and coriander, if you like. Serve with the lime wedges for squeezing over.

title: Cajun spiced fish tacos
description: Tilapia fillets coated in Cajun seasoning and baked on a hot sheet, then flaked into corn tortillas with a lime cabbage slaw and a creamy cilantro lime dressing. Makes 12 tacos.

ingredients.name: cajun
ingredients.note: Cajun seasoning (the recipe page says blackened seasoning); 2-3

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: cooking spray, for greasing the hot baking sheet and the tops of the fish

ingredients.name: cabbage
ingredients.note: green and purple, shredded, for the slaw

ingredients.name: lime
ingredients.note: 1 juiced for the slaw, 1 cut into wedges to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C and put a baking sheet in to heat.
For the dressing, blend the sour cream, milk, juice of half a lime, a pinch of salt, black pepper and chopped cilantro until smooth. Refrigerate until you assemble.
Sprinkle both sides of the tilapia with the Cajun seasoning. Take the hot sheet out, coat it generously with cooking spray, lay the fillets on it, spray their tops and return it to the oven.
Bake for 10-12 minutes (the recipe page says about 15, depending on thickness) until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily.
While the fish bakes, toss the cabbage with the juice of 1 lime and the salt in a medium bowl for the slaw.
Chop or flake the fish into chunks.
Put some slaw on each warmed tortilla, top with chunks of fish and a generous drizzle of the dressing, sprinkle with cilantro and serve with the lime wedges.

title: Slow-braised chilli beef
description: Bone-in beef shin braised for four hours with chipotle paste, paprika and tomatoes, shredded with kidney beans and served in tortillas with avocado and soured cream.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: half to brown the beef, half for the onions

ingredients.name: avocado
ingredients.note: ripe, cut into chunks, to serve

ingredients.name: chilli
ingredients.note: large red, finely sliced, to serve

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 150 C. Warm half the oil in a large casserole over high heat, season the beef and brown it in batches, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil, the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the paprika and chipotle paste, then return the beef with the sugar, tomatoes and stock and bring to the boil.
Cover tightly and cook in the oven for 4 hours until the meat is tender and the sauce reduced.
Discard large pieces of fat and the bones, keeping the marrow in the pan, and stir hard to break the meat into small pieces. Mix in the beans.
Return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes until thickened, then rest for 15 minutes and season.
Serve with warm tortillas topped with avocado, chilli, coriander and soured cream, plus lime wedges.

title: Stuffed peppers with quinoa
description: Sweet peppers filled with quinoa, black beans and melted cheese.

steps.text: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish or a similar-sized casserole dish.
Place the bell pepper halves in the prepared baking dish, cut side up. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until slightly softened.

While the bell peppers are baking, prepare the filling. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the chopped onion, and cook for 3-4 minutes, until softened. Add the garlic, and cook for another 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the cooked quinoa, black beans, corn, diced tomatoes, ground cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook for 5-7 minutes, until heated through.
Remove the skillet from heat, and stir in 1 cup of the shredded cheese, if using.
Remove the bell peppers from the oven, and carefully stuff each pepper half with the quinoa and black bean mixture. Top the stuffed peppers with the remaining 1/2 cup of shredded cheese, if using.
Return the stuffed peppers to the oven, and bake for another 15-20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the peppers are tender.
Remove from the oven, and allow the stuffed peppers to cool for 5 minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh chopped cilantro.

title: Ratatouille
description: A layered Provençal-style ratatouille of sliced aubergine, courgette, tomato, onion and peppers baked over a blended roasted red pepper, tomato and saffron sauce.

ingredients.name: capsicum
ingredients.note: red, de-seeded and cut, roasted for the sauce

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: about 3 glugs in total, plus more to drizzle

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.note: peeled and finely chopped, half in the sauce and half on the veg

ingredients.name: thyme
ingredients.note: leaves stripped, half in the sauce and half on the veg

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.note: beef tomatoes, sliced into 1 cm rounds

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 C. De-seed and cut the two red peppers, toss them with olive oil and seasoning and roast for 15 minutes until softened and starting to char. Then turn the oven down to 160 C.
Meanwhile make the sauce. Put the tinned tomatoes in a saucepan with a glug of oil, half the chopped garlic and thyme and the bay leaf. Steep the saffron in 100 ml warm water and add it.
Simmer the sauce for about 10 minutes. Blend it with the roasted red peppers until smooth.

Slice the courgette, aubergine, red onion, beef tomatoes and yellow pepper into rounds or pieces about 1 cm thick. Toss them gently with a little olive oil, salt, pepper and the remaining garlic and thyme.
Spread the blended sauce over the base of a baking dish. Arrange the sliced vegetables on top in an overlapping pattern of alternating colours.
Drizzle with a little more oil and a splash of balsamic vinegar. Bake at 160 C for 30 minutes.
Turn the oven up to 220 C and bake for a final 30 minutes.
Scatter over parsley leaves and drizzle with more olive oil. Serve with fresh baguette.

title: Coq au vin
description: Chicken marinated in red wine and braised in the oven with a reduced wine and cognac sauce, served with caramelised pearl onions, bacon, mushrooms and croutons.

ingredients.name: chicken
ingredients.note: pieces, thighs work best, or one deboned whole chicken

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.note: peanut or sunflower, for the marinade

ingredients.name: chicken stock
ingredients.note: good-quality ready-made brown stock, reduced before use

ingredients.name: brandy
